name: Decomposer
title: Decomposer: Editable Scientific Figure Reconstruction with Evolving Knowledge
description_zh: 将科研图解析为结构化组件，并重建为可编辑的 PowerPoint 原生对象。通过诊断与局部修复闭环积累可复用经验，覆盖文字、公式、图像、图表、箭头与形状。
description_en: Parsing scientific figures into structured components and reconstructing them as editable PowerPoint objects. A diagnosis-and-repair loop accumulates reusable knowledge across text, equations, images, charts, arrows, and shapes.

name: FigureCrafter
title: Learning to Draw: An Evolving Framework for Editable Scientific Figures
description_zh: 从论文理解、参考学习与布局设计出发，构建原生绘制、渲染检查与迭代修订流程，探索科学表达、视觉质量和可编辑性之间的平衡。
description_en: Building a workflow from paper understanding, reference learning, and layout planning to native drawing, render inspection, and iterative revision, balancing scientific communication, visual quality, and editability.

name: ReviewBoundary
title: ReviewBoundary: Separating Ideas from Evidence in AI Peer Review
description_zh: 研究 AI 评审中想法价值与实验完整度的混淆，通过主张预先固定、证据映射与必要性审查，为论文评审提供可追溯的依据。
description_en: Studying how AI peer review conflates the value of an idea with experimental completeness. Claim freezing, evidence mapping, and necessity checks make review judgments traceable.

name: Reward Models Survey
title: Good Teachers, Better Students: A Survey of Reward Models for LLM
status_en: Under review at ACM Computing Surveys
institution_zh: 东北大学 · Data Mining Group
description_zh: 系统梳理奖励模型在偏好对齐与推理能力提升中的作用。负责数据处理、强化学习与 Test-Time Scaling 相关章节，参与全稿修订、文献检索和论文排版。
description_en: Surveying reward models for preference alignment and reasoning. Wrote sections on data processing, reinforcement learning, and test-time scaling, and contributed to full-manuscript revision, literature review, and typesetting.

name: Entropy Survey
title: A Survey on Entropy Mechanism in Large Reasoning Models
institution_zh: 东北大学 · Data Mining Group
description_zh: 围绕大推理模型中的熵机制与 GRPO 相关算法开展综述研究。参与数十种方法的资料整理与数据统计、研究结论归纳，并建设项目 GitHub 仓库。
description_en: Studied entropy mechanisms in large reasoning models and entropy-related GRPO methods. Contributed method summaries, data analysis, literature synthesis, and the project’s GitHub repository.

name: CASE
title: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
role_zh: 第三作者 · 科研助理
description_zh: 参与多模态情感识别研究的基线实验，在 EMER、DFEW 与 CA-MER 数据集上评测 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、MoSERA 和 Emotion-LLaMA，为论文中的模型性能比较提供实验结果。
description_en: Contributed baseline experiments for multimodal emotion recognition, evaluating Qwen2.5-VL-7B, MoSERA, and Emotion-LLaMA on EMER, DFEW, and CA-MER and providing results for model comparisons.

name: Coding Agent Data Survey
title: From Tasks to Learning Signals: A Survey of Data for Coding Agents
description_zh: 从数据视角梳理编程智能体，连接基准评测、任务构建、交互轨迹生成与筛选，以及学习信号的形成。参与论文撰写。
description_en: Studied coding agents from a data perspective, connecting benchmark evaluation, task construction, interaction-trajectory generation and curation, and the formation of learning signals. Contributed to paper writing.

name: CF-MoE
title: CF-MoE: Decision-Aligned Credit Factorization for Mixture-of-Experts Agents
description_zh: 研究混合专家智能体中专家选择与动作生成共享信用信号的问题，围绕两类决策的信用分解开展研究，负责论文撰写与方法表述。
description_en: Studied shared credit signals for expert selection and action generation in mixture-of-experts agents, focusing on decision-aligned credit factorization. Responsible for paper writing and method presentation.

name: Skill-MoE
title: Skill-MoE: Multi-View Skill Induction for Auditable LLM Agents
description_zh: 围绕智能体的多视角技能归纳、可审计技能与持续演化开展研究，探索支持智能体能力积累和迭代改进的机制，负责论文撰写。
description_en: Explored multi-view skill induction, auditable skills, and continual evolution for LLM agents, investigating mechanisms for accumulating and improving agent capabilities. Responsible for paper writing.
